chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Combing the head removes ailments, and combing the beard strengthens the teeth."

key_terms.الرَّأْسِ: the head; here meaning the hair of the head
key_terms.مَشْطُ: combing; the act or tool of grooming

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about combing the hair and beard?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches a benefit of personal grooming, linking combing the head and beard with bodily well-being. The hadith reflects the Islamic emphasis on cleanliness, adornment, and beneficial everyday habits.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.319 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Combing the hair removes ailments, and combing the beard strengthens the teeth."
